subject.title: feat(gateway): propagate approvals to ancestor sessions

question: Does the new `session.approval` audience and reviewer-authorization model expose exactly the intended sanitized approval data to ancestor-session subscribers?
rationale: The change intentionally expands approval observability across session ancestry; automated tests verify mechanics, but maintainers must approve the disclosure boundary and trust model.

options.title: Approve the boundary
options.body: Accept exact persisted ancestor audiences plus record-level reviewer authorization after the repair and live-proof gates are satisfied.

options.title: Narrow the projection
options.body: Limit delivery to the source session or a smaller explicit audience until broader ancestor visibility is approved.

options.title: Pause this slice
options.body: Land the underlying durable approval work without ancestor-session projection.

recommendation.title: Approve the boundary
recommendation.body: Accept exact persisted ancestor audiences plus record-level reviewer authorization after the repair and live-proof gates are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and reviewer-binding authorization model originate in their approval-stack work, and they have substantial history in the central gateway paths.
